# hivelocity_user_permissions (Data Source)

Lists the permissions of the user owning the API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_user_permissions" "me" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permission names of the current user.
